scenarios.name: Inspect the ribbon locations of an available command

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Ribbon customization dialog shows All Commands and an empty Part Tools target
the user clicks "2D Sketches" in the available command list
the user presses End and then Home while the pointer remains over that row
a tooltip for "2D Sketches" lists its Part and Assembly locations
both locations identify the View tab and Visibility panel
the target custom panel remains empty
